created_for: Phase 3-01 Official Source Registry and Hazard/Shelter Data Planning

policy.notes: This registry records candidate sources for future review. P3-01 does not download, scrape, parse GIS, parse CityGML, or modify Unity.

candidates.source_name: Chuo City Open Data - Designated Emergency Shelter List
candidates.unity_relevance: High. Candidate primary shelter/facility point source for future Unity shelter markers.
candidates.notes: Use as the first official shelter-facility source candidate after license and field review. Do not replace P2 test_shelters.json in P3.

candidates.source_name: Tokyo Disaster Prevention Map Shelter List
candidates.unity_relevance: High. Candidate cross-check or fallback source for Tokyo-wide evacuation shelters and evacuation places.
candidates.notes: Filter to Chuo City records only in a future ingestion phase. Confirm attribution requirements before use.

candidates.source_name: Chuo City Disaster Prevention Portal Facility Map
candidates.unity_relevance: Medium. Useful for manual verification of shelter categories, opening status, and public-facing map semantics.
candidates.notes: Treat as manual review context unless an explicit downloadable open-data endpoint is approved later.

candidates.source_name: Chuo City Flood Hazard Map and Inundation Record Map
candidates.unity_relevance: Medium. Useful for manual hazard interpretation and visual QA, but PDF maps are not preferred primary pipeline geometry.
candidates.notes: Use for context and manual comparison. Prefer machine-readable polygon/depth data for automated hazard ingestion.

candidates.source_name: Tokyo Storm Surge Inundation Assumption Area Data
candidates.unity_relevance: High. Candidate machine-readable hazard layer for future risk-zone planning and depth-based visualization.
candidates.notes: Large GIS archive expected. Do not download in P3-01. Future ingestion should clip/filter to Chuo area and validate CRS.

candidates.unity_relevance: Medium. Relevant to tsunami semantics, but current Tokyo tsunami assumptions may focus on island areas and must be checked for Chuo applicability.
candidates.notes: Review scope carefully before using for Chuo mainland gameplay. Do not infer Chuo inundation from island-only products.

candidates.source_name: MLIT Real Estate Information Library - Tsunami Inundation Information
candidates.organization: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
candidates.unity_relevance: Medium. Potential national reference for tsunami inundation data, subject to API terms and Chuo coverage.
candidates.notes: Future work must review API key, terms, commercial/non-commercial limits, and whether Tokyo mainland records are available.

candidates.unity_relevance: Low. May help manual QA, but must not be treated as primary pipeline data.
candidates.notes: Use only to spot-check official data coverage. Do not ingest unless explicitly approved and license-reviewed.

candidates.source_name: Academic Papers or Secondary Hazard Maps for Tokyo Bay / Chuo Risk Context
candidates.unity_relevance: Low. Useful for design context and manual comparison only.
candidates.notes: Paper maps may inform assumptions and review questions but should not be primary geometry or official shelter/facility records.
